variabel.text: Create the variable `namn` (Swedish for “name”) containing your name, and then use `echo` to print `Hej` (“Hi”) followed by the name.

substitution.text: Save the number of lines in `~/dokument/server.log` in the variable `rader`, using `$(...)` and `wc -l`.
substitution.hint: `wc -l < file` prints just the number, without the file name: `rader=$(wc -l < ~/dokument/server.log)`

if.text: Write an `if` statement that prints `finns` (“exists”) if the file `~/.bashrc` exists.
if.hint: `if [ -f ~/.bashrc ]; then echo finns; fi` – don't forget the spaces inside the square brackets.

for.text: Print the numbers 1 to 5, one per line, with a `for` loop.
for.hint: Either `for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do ...; done` or `for i in $(seq 1 5); do ...; done`.

while-read.text: Read `~/dokument/frukter.txt` line by line with `while read` and print `Frukt: ` (Swedish for “Fruit”) in front of each line.

funktion.text: Create the function `dubbla` (“double”) that prints its first argument times two. Test it with `dubbla 21`.

backup.text: Write the script `~/backup.sh`, which copies the file given as the first argument to the same name with `.bak` at the end. Make it executable and run `./backup.sh anteckningar.txt` in your home directory.
backup.hint: Create the file with `cat > ~/backup.sh << 'SLUT'`, write `#!/bin/bash` and `cp "$1" "$1.bak"` on separate lines, and finish with `SLUT`.
